content.short: Design-focused self-custody Ethereum wallet for iOS from the makers of ConnectKit.
content.description: Family is an iOS wallet built to make Ethereum feel friendly. Users send tokens and NFTs to any address or ENS name, receive through a personal QR code, swap at aggregated prices without leaving the app, and buy crypto from their bank account. It has full NFT support, and the same team builds ConnectKit, the popular wallet connection library for web apps.
content.meta: Family is a design-led self-custody Ethereum wallet for iOS with swaps, ENS sends and full NFT support.
